name: ocpp2mqtt
description: ocpp2mqtt is a gateway software that converts OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol) requests to MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) and vice versa. This allows the integration of charging stations with any automation system.

ports.name: OCPP Port
ports.description: Port mapping for OCPP connection. The host side must match LISTEN_PORT value

variables.name: LISTEN_PORT
variables.description: Port to listen for incoming OCPP connection. If this is change, you must update the OCPP PORT port forwarding

variables.name: LISTEN_ADDR
variables.description: If using multiple NIC, used to bind to a specific address

variables.name: MQTT_BASEPATH
variables.description: Basepath to use for mqtt. State and command will be after that

variables.name: MQTT_USERNAME
variables.description: Username to connect to MQTT if required

variables.name: MQTT_USESTATIONNAME
variables.description: Set to true (all lower) to append the station name to the MQTT_BASEPATH. Be sure the basepath end with /

variables.name: AUTHORIZED_TAG_ID_LIST
variables.description: List of station ID that are authorized to charge. You can get this value in your station apps.
